faq.q: Which school is located in this area?
faq.a: Evans Elementary, Kindergarten to Grade 5, is at 7600 Evans Road; middle and secondary catchments for a home address must be checked in the SD33 locator.

faq.q: What bus routes serve the area?
faq.a: Route 52 Evans runs between Cottonwood Mall and downtown Chilliwack via Evans Road and Yale Road, and route 59 Industrial runs peak-period weekday trips between Downtown Chilliwack, Cottonwood Mall and the Lickman Park & Ride.

faq.q: What does the Agricultural Area Plan cover?
faq.a: The plan covers the western rural and agricultural land of the City of Chilliwack, where the farm sector is dominated by dairy and poultry operations, nurseries and greenhouses; it is a schedule of the Official Community Plan.
